pope-shenouda-iii.name: H.H. Pope Shenouda III
pope-shenouda-iii.bio: The 117th Pope of Alexandria wrote extensively on prayer, repentance, Scripture, and Orthodox theology.

pope-tawadros-ii.name: H.H. Pope Tawadros II
pope-tawadros-ii.bio: The 118th Pope of Alexandria and Patriarch of the See of St. Mark.

pope-kyrillos-vi.name: St. Pope Kyrillos VI
pope-kyrillos-vi.bio: The 116th Pope of Alexandria, remembered for his life of prayer.

fr-matta-el-meskeen.name: Fr. Matta El Meskeen
fr-matta-el-meskeen.bio: A Coptic Orthodox monk and writer on prayer, Scripture, and spiritual life.

fr-tadros-yacoub-malaty.name: Fr. Tadros Yacoub Malaty

fr-anthony-messeh.name: Fr. Anthony Messeh
fr-anthony-messeh.bio: A Coptic Orthodox priest whose teachings focus on Christian discipleship.

st-athanasius.name: St. Athanasius the Apostolic

st-cyril-of-alexandria.name: St. Cyril of Alexandria
st-cyril-of-alexandria.bio: An Alexandrian patriarch whose writings defend the unity of Christ and Mary as Theotokos.

st-john-chrysostom.name: St. John Chrysostom
st-john-chrysostom.bio: A Church Father known for biblical homilies and pastoral teaching.

st-basil-the-great.name: St. Basil the Great
st-basil-the-great.bio: A Church Father known for his theological, monastic, and pastoral writings.

st-augustine.name: Augustine of Hippo
st-augustine.bio: An influential early Christian bishop and theological writer.

st-isaac-the-syrian.name: St. Isaac the Syrian
st-isaac-the-syrian.bio: An ascetic writer whose works explore prayer, repentance, and spiritual life.

st-severus-of-antioch.name: St. Severus of Antioch
st-severus-of-antioch.bio: A Father of the Oriental Orthodox tradition known for his Christological writings.

church-publications.bio: Publications issued by churches and Orthodox institutions.
